description:
Use this when the user asks what a term or ratio on an Indian company's page means or how it is calculated: P/E, ROE, TTM, gross NPA, promoter pledge and the like. It defines terms and never says whether a value is good or bad.

Plain-words definitions of the terms and metrics DalalOS reports.

    `term` is one or more comma-separated keys or metric ids (for example `pe,market_cap`);
    `kind` narrows to metric, line_item, term or section. Each entry has `plain_description`,
    `basis_text` (the inputs, unit and period basis), `applies_to` (company types) and
    `not_meaningful_when` where a value is null for a reason. A definition says what a term is and
    how it is calculated; it never says whether a value is good or bad. `reviewed_by` is null until
    a reviewer has approved the wording. In-process metadata; no database or network.
name: get_glossary
title: Plain-words glossary
